description: A warrior of the Horde, Regthar Deathgate, is recruiting agents for a mission into the land of Desolace.  Speak with him if you wish to volunteer.  He is stationed in the Barrens, in a series of bunkers west of the Crossroads.
And sharpen your weapons.  Desolace is a place torn by war.
completion: Yes, I am recruiting. This mission leads into Desolace, against the centaur there. I will be brief so that you may quickly begin.
